MaAsLin3 does FDR correction over all abundance or prevalence relationships 
(separately). P-values are now adjusted only within the variable of interest,
Year_cat to gain more meaningful results. This is done to abundance and 
prevalence separately, as the default FDR corrections.

Significant results are features that satisfy the following criteria:
(1) re-adjusted qval_individual < 0.10
(2) no errors in model fitting

```{r}
maaslin_res <- read.table("MaAsLin3_Human_Years/all_results.tsv", header=TRUE, sep="\t")

signif_abundance <- maaslin_res %>%
  filter(metadata=="Year_cat",
         model=="abundance") %>%
  mutate(qval_individual_readj = p.adjust(pval_individual, method="BH")) %>%
  filter(qval_individual_readj < 0.10,
         is.na(error))

signif_prevalence <- maaslin_res %>%
  filter(metadata=="Year_cat",
         model=="prevalence") %>%
  mutate(qval_individual_readj = p.adjust(pval_individual, method="BH")) %>%
  filter(qval_individual_readj < 0.10,
         is.na(error))
```

## Heatmap of differentially abundant viral species

```{r}
plot_heatmap <- function(data, original_data, test){

   if (test=="a"){
    signif_features <- data %>%
      filter(model=="abundance")
  }else{
    signif_features <- data %>%
      filter(model=="prevalence")
  }
  
  
  #get the names of significant features, subset the original data based on that
  plot_data <- t(original_data[colnames(original_data) %in% signif_features$feature])
  rownames(plot_data) <- sub("s__", "", rownames(plot_data))
  pal <- park_palette("DeathValley")

 # return(plot_data)
  #column annotations
  annot_col <- data.frame(Year = c(rep("2020-2021", 60), rep("2024-2025", 60)))
  rownames(annot_col) <- colnames(plot_data)
  annot_colors_col <- list(Year = c("2020-2021" = pal[6], "2024-2025" = pal[1]))
  
  #row annotations
  row_annot <- data.frame(Enriched_in= c(rep("hold", nrow(plot_data))))
  rownames(row_annot) <- rownames(plot_data)
  
  
  for (i in c(1:nrow(row_annot))){
    row_annot[i, "Enriched_in"] <- ifelse(data[gsub("s__", "", data$feature) == rownames(row_annot)[i], c("coef")] < 0,
                                 "2020-2021", "2024-2025")

  }

  annot_colors <- list(Enriched_in = c("2020-2021" = pal[6], "2024-2025" = pal[1]),
                       Year = c("2020-2021" = pal[6], "2024-2025" = pal[1]))
   
  main_title = ifelse(test=="a", "Differentially abundant species",
                "Differentially prevalent species")
  
  if (test=="a" | test=="p"){
    plot_data <- log2(plot_data+1)
    scale_opt <- "row"
    breaks_opt <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 101)
    color_opt <- inferno(100)
  }else{
    plot_data <- as.data.frame(ifelse(plot_data >0, 1, 0))
    scale_opt <- "none"
    breaks_opt <- seq(0,1, length.out = 3)
    color_opt <- plasma(2)
  }
  
  #return(plot_data)
  plot <- pheatmap(plot_data,
           color = color_opt,
           cluster_rows = TRUE,
           clustering_distance_rows="euclidean",
           cluster_cols = FALSE,
           show_colnames = FALSE,
           cellheight = 8,
           cellwidth = 2.5,
           fontsize = 8,
           scale = scale_opt,
           annotation_col = annot_col,
           annotation_row = row_annot,
           annotation_colors = annot_colors,
           annotation_names_row = FALSE,
           breaks = breaks_opt,
           main = main_title)

  return(plot)
  
}

```

```{r}
plot_heatmap(signif_prevalence, maaslin_in_hspecies, "p")
```

## Quadrant plot of signficant MaAsLin results 

A summary quadrant plot of MaAsLin results shows viral traits, with the x-axis indicating acute versus persistent viruses and the y-axis indicating pathogenic versus commensal classification; red denotes viruses more prevalent and abundant in 2020–2021 and violet in 2024–2025, while point size reflects the q-value.

```{r}
pathogenic_comm_species <-  fread(here("data", "Human_data.tsv"))

pathogenic_comm_species <- unique(pathogenic_comm_species[, c("species", "Life-style")])
colnames(pathogenic_comm_species) <- c("species", "Life_style")

acute_persistent_species <- fread(here("MaAsLin3_significant_species_Acute_Persistent_Unknown.txt"), sep=",", header=FALSE)
colnames(acute_persistent_species) <- c("feature", "inf_type")


signif_all <- rbind(signif_abundance, signif_prevalence)

signif_all_annot <- merge(signif_all, pathogenic_comm_species,
                          by.x="feature", by.y="species", all.x = FALSE,
                            all.y=FALSE) %>%
                        distinct() %>%
                    merge(., acute_persistent_species, by.x="feature", by.y="feature") %>%
                    filter(Life_style %in% c("Commensal", "Pathogenic"),
                           inf_type!="Unknown")
```

filter only the relevant information for quadrant plot plotting
for each significant feature, keep only one entry if both prevalence and abundance
were significant, then keep the smallest FDR corrected qval

If some features have opposite coefficients between abundance and prevalence testing,
the test with smaller qvalue is shown

```{r}
quadrant_plot_data <- signif_all_annot %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  arrange(qval_individual) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  summarize(coef=coef,
            qval_individual_readj = min(qval_individual_readj),
            Life_style=Life_style,
            inf_type=inf_type) 
  
```

create quadrant figure from the persistent/acute and commensial/pathogenic axis
    
    pathogenic   a     |    b
    -------------------------------
    commensial   c     |    d
               acute      persistent

```{r}
#calculate the features belonging to each category

a <- quadrant_plot_data %>%
  filter(Life_style=="Pathogenic",
         inf_type=="Acute") 
  
b <- quadrant_plot_data %>%
  filter(Life_style=="Pathogenic",
         inf_type=="Persistent")

c <- quadrant_plot_data %>%
  filter(Life_style=="Commensal",
         inf_type=="Acute")

d <- quadrant_plot_data %>%
  filter(Life_style=="Commensal",
         inf_type=="Persistent")

nrow(a)
nrow(b)
nrow(c)
nrow(d)
```
IDEA kuvan tekemiseen:

valmistele jokaiselle ruudulle oma grid ja niiden koordinaatti yhdistelmät
(vaikka 1000 pistettä per ruutu)

ja sitten niistä koordinaattipareista valitse randomilla nrow(ruudun lajit)
```{r}

# Build an evenly spaced grid of k*k points inside [xmin, xmax] × [ymin, ymax]
# with a proportional margin on all sides to avoid edges.
make_even_grid <- function(k, xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, margin = 0.1) {
  stopifnot(k >= 2)
  xrange <- xmax - xmin
  yrange <- ymax - ymin
  
  # shrink box by margin percentage
  xmin2 <- xmin + margin * xrange
  xmax2 <- xmax - margin * xrange
  ymin2 <- ymin + margin * yrange
  ymax2 <- ymax - margin * yrange
  
  xs <- seq(xmin2, xmax2, length.out = k)
  ys <- seq(ymin2, ymax2, length.out = k)
  grid <- expand.grid(x = xs, y = ys)
  grid
}


```

Generate 10,000 possible coordinates for each panel

```{r}
k <- 20
margin=0.1
a_coords <- make_even_grid(k, xmin = -1, xmax =  0, ymin =  0, ymax = 1, margin = margin)
b_coords <- make_even_grid(k, xmin =  0, xmax =  1, ymin =  0, ymax =  1, margin = margin)
c_coords <- make_even_grid(k, xmin = -1, xmax =  0, ymin = -1, ymax =  0, margin = margin)
d_coords <- make_even_grid(k, xmin =  0, xmax =  1, ymin = -1, ymax =  0, margin = margin)

```


Then randomly sample right number of coordinates for each panel

```{r}
#set.seed(5)
set.seed(5)
a_sample <- a_coords[sample(nrow(a_coords), nrow(a)), , drop = FALSE]
a$x <- a_sample$x
a$y <- a_sample$y

b_sample <- b_coords[sample(nrow(b_coords), nrow(b)), , drop = FALSE]
b$x <- b_sample$x
b$y <- b_sample$y
set.seed(10)
c_sample <- c_coords[sample(nrow(c_coords), nrow(c)), , drop = FALSE]
c$x <- c_sample$x
c$y <- c_sample$y

d_sample <- d_coords[sample(nrow(d_coords), nrow(d)), , drop = FALSE]
d$x <- d_sample$x
d$y <- d_sample$y

a$category <- "pathogenic_acute"
b$category <- "pathogenic_persistent"
c$category <- "commensal_acute"
d$category <- "commensal_persistent"

data_all <- rbind(a,b,c,d)
data_all$qval_size <- 1/(data_all$qval_individual_readj)

data_all$more_abundant_in <- ifelse(data_all$coef < 0, "2020-2021", "2024-2025")
```


```{r}
pal <- park_palette("DeathValley")

quadrant <- ggplot(data_all) +
  geom_point(aes(x=x, y=y, size=(-log10(qval_individual_readj)*abs(coef)), 
                 color=more_abundant_in, alpha=0.5)) +
  scale_color_manual(values= c(pal[6], pal[1]),
                     labels=c("2020-2021", "2024-2025"))+
  labs(x="", y="") +
  theme_bw()  +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(-0.5, 0.5),
                   labels=c("Acute","Persistent")) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(-0.5, 0.5),
                   labels=c("Commensal", "Pathogenic")) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth=1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth=1) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color="black", linewidth=1),
        text = element_text(family = "Arial", size=14, color="black"))

ggsave(quadrant, file = here("outputs/Figures/final_figures", "quadrant_plot_DAA.jpg"), 
        width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", dpi=300)

```
